race.description: Tiny Tins Trash Dash Mdn Plate
race.comment: FOVEA (12) is a Farnan filly from the stakes-winning mare Jennifer Eccles. Looks forward enough following a trial win with Winona Costin aboard. Expected to go well. EVICTION NOTICE (9) was prominent at the turn and progressed nicely last start to finish a close third over 1100m at Gosford after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Has his share of ability but is becoming frustrating for his supporters. PONZI SCHEME (10) returns. Was good on debut without winning when tackling the Wellington Boot. Has been fitted with a trial and is drawn favourably. Can make a bright return. KAVEH (4) Prince Fawaz gelding from La Pintana who is on debut. Has only trialled once and scored. Watch for any market confidence.
